An issue has been identified with the a small amount of grip strength data ( Field 46 and Field 47 ) collected in Cheadle during the first repeat visit in 2013 (Instance 1). We are working on modelling a correction factor for this data. In the meantime, researchers are advised to treat the 2013 grip strength data with caution. In particular, readings from dynamometer 7336 are lower than expected. The mean error is approximately 2 kg for readings taken in January 2013, gradually increasing to a mean error of 14 kg for readings taken in June 2013. The dynamometer was recalibrated after June 2013, during scheduled yearly external calibration, and there is no evidence of problems with dynamometer 7336 during instances 0, 2 or 3.

Field_zh: 是否曾进行过肠癌筛查
Notes_zh: ACE触摸屏问题'您是否曾进行过肠（结直肠）癌筛查？（包括粪便潜血试验、结肠镜检查或乙状结肠镜检查）'如果参与者点击了帮助按钮，会显示以下信息：肠或结直肠癌筛查包括：- FOBT（粪便潜血试验）- 您会收到一组卡片，并被要求在三个不同场合将部分粪便涂抹在卡片上，然后返回卡片进行血液检测。- 乙状结肠镜检查- 使用管子检查下肠。通常在医生办公室进行，无需止痛。- 结肠镜检查- 使用长管检查整个大肠；通常需要饮用大量特殊液体准备肠道，并在手术中使用镇静药物。
Notes: ACE touchscreen question "Have you ever had a screening test for bowel (colorectal) cancer? (Please include tests for blood in the stool/faeces or a colonoscopy or a sigmoidoscopy)" If the participant activated the Help button they were shown the message: Screening tests for bowel or colorectal cancer include: - FOBT (faecal occult blood test) - this is when you are given a set of cards and asked to smear a part of your stool on three separate occasions onto the cards and then return the cards to be tested for blood. - Sigmoidoscopy - a tube is used to examine the lower bowel. This is usually done in a doctor's office without pain relief. - Colonoscopy - a long tube is used the examine the whole large bowel; you would usually have to drink a large amount of special liquid to prepare the bowel, and you would be given a sedative medication for the procedure.

Notes_zh: 肺功能测试结果的可接受性（位字段）：START_OF_TEST 如果测试开始时的外推体积过大则设置=0x01；TIME_TO_PEF 如果达到峰值流量的时间过长则设置=0x02；END_OF_TEST 如果测试结束时没有足够的平台期则设置=0x04；COUGHING 如果在操作过程中检测到咳嗽则设置=0x08；TEST_DURATION 如果测试时间少于6秒则设置=0x10；USER_ACCEPTED 指定测试是否被研究者明确接受=0x20；USER_REJECTED 指定测试是否被研究者明确拒绝=0x40。因此，十进制值24（0x08+0x10）表示在检测到咳嗽的情况下测试时间少于6秒。
Notes: Acceptability of spirometry result (bit field) START_OF_TEST Set if the extrapolated volume at start of test is excessive = 0x01 TIME_TO_PEF Set if time to peak flow is excessive = 0x02 END_OF_TEST Set if an adequate plateau at the end of the test does not exist = 0x04 COUGHING Set if a cough was detected during the manovoure = 0x08 TEST_DURATION Set if the test is less than 6 seconds = 0x10 USER_ACCEPTED Specifies whether or not the test was explicitly acceped by the investigator = 0x20 USER_REJECTED Specifies whether or not the test was explicitly rejected by the investigator = 0x40 Hence a decimal value of 24 (0x08+0x10) indicates a test of less than 6 seconds during which a cough was detected.

Field: Pulse wave pressure versus time response curve
Field_zh: 脉搏波压力-时间响应曲线
Notes_zh: 包含3个波形的波数据，每个波形由一个直接分量和一个反射分量组成。数字容积脉搏可以视为直接分量和反射分量的总和。直接分量是由于压力波从左心室通过最直接路径传输到手指。反射分量是由心脏传输到下半身的压力形成，在下半身反射回主动脉再到手指。每个波形实际上是一个包含100个点的单脉冲。由于心率以每分钟心跳次数表示，单次心跳时间为60秒/心率，两次心跳之间的时间为(60/心率)/100。数据格式如下：第一个数字（即第一个'|'字符前的数字）表示曲线的X,Y点数。每对X,Y值与前/后对之间用'|'字符分隔。每对X,Y值内部用','字符分隔。X轴为时间（毫秒），Y轴为脉搏信号强度（任意单位）。
Notes: Wave data containing 3 waveforms, each consisting of one direct and one reflected component. A digital volume pulse can be considered to be the summation of a direct and a reflected component. The direct component is due to transmission of a pressure wave from the left ventricle to the finger via the most direct route. The reflected component is formed by pressure transmitted from the heart to the lower body where it is reflected back up the aorta and thence to the finger. Each waveform is actually a single pulse with 100 points. Since the heart rate is in beats per minute, a single beat takes 60seconds / Heart Rate and time between two beats is (60/Heart Rate)/100. The data is formatted as follows: The first number (i.e. digits before the first '|' character)indicate the number of points X,Y for the curve. Each pair of X,Y values is separated by a '|' character from the preceding/succeeding pair. Each pair of X,Y values is separated internally by a ',' character. The X-axis is the time in milliseconds and the Y-axis is the Pulse signal strength in arbitrary units.

Path: Assessment centre > Touchscreen > Family history
Field_zh: 年长兄弟姐妹数量
Notes_zh: 该问题于2009年4月现场调查中期引入。ACE触屏问题：'你有多少年长的兄弟/姐妹？（包括已去世者和双胞胎，不包括同父异母/异父同母、继亲或领养的兄弟姐妹）'。数据校验规则：答案<0时拒绝；>25时拒绝；>10时需参与者确认。排除童年被领养者（由字段1767定义）。特殊编码：-1表示'不知道'，-3表示'不愿回答'。
Notes: This question was introduced part way through fieldwork in April 2009. ACE touchscreen question "How many OLDER brothers/sisters do you have? (Please include those who have died, and twins. Do not include half-, step- or adopted brothers and sisters)" The following checks were performed: If answer < 0 then rejected If answer > 25 then rejected If answer > 10 then participant asked to confirm Field 5057 was collected from participants except those who indicated they were adopted as a child, as defined by their answers to Field 1767 Coding 100291 defines 2 special values: -1 represents "Do not know" -3 represents "Prefer not to answer"
Data: 259,066 items of data are available, covering 210,830 participants.Some values have special meanings defined by Data-Coding 100291.Defined-instances run from 0 to 3, labelled using Instancing 2.

Field_zh: 每次吹气结果的可接受性（试点）
Notes_zh: 肺活量测定结果的可接受性（位字段）。START_OF_TEST：如果测试开始时的外推体积过大，则设置为0x01；TIME_TO_PEF：如果达到峰值流量的时间过长，则设置为0x02；END_OF_TEST：如果测试结束时没有足够的平台期，则设置为0x04；COUGHING：如果在操作期间检测到咳嗽，则设置为0x08；TEST_DURATION：如果测试时间少于6秒，则设置为0x10；USER_ACCEPTED：指定测试是否被研究者明确接受，设置为0x20；USER_REJECTED：指定测试是否被研究者明确拒绝，设置为0x40。因此，十进制值24（0x08+0x10）表示在检测到咳嗽的情况下测试时间少于6秒。
Notes: Acceptability of spirometry result (bit field) START_OF_TEST Set if the extrapolated volume at start of test is excessive = 0x01 TIME_TO_PEF Set if time to peak flow is excessive = 0x02 END_OF_TEST Set if an adequate plateau at the end of the test does not exist = 0x04 COUGHING Set if a cough was detected during the manovoure = 0x08 TEST_DURATION Set if the test is less than 6 seconds = 0x10 USER_ACCEPTED Specifies whether or not the test was explicitly acceped by the investigator = 0x20 USER_REJECTED Specifies whether or not the test was explicitly rejected by the investigator = 0x40 Hence a decimal value of 24 (0x08+0x10) indicates a test of less than 6 seconds during which a cough was detected.

Notes: This is the interpolated time when the participant indicated the corresponding cancer was first diagnosed by a doctor, measured in years. If the participant gave a calendar year, then the best-fit time is half-way through that year. For example, if the participant said they were 30 years old then the value is the date at which they were 30years+6months. Interpolated values before the date of birth were truncated forwards to that time. Interpolated values after the time of data acquisition were truncated back to that time. Notes: This field contains the combined results of 2 ACE touchscreen questions, both asked "Has/did your father ever suffer from? (You can select more than one answer)" for different sets of illnesses. For convenience, the illnesses were arbitrarily divided into two sets: Group 1 : Heart disease, Stroke, High blood pressure, Chronic bronchitis/emphysema, Alzheimer's disease/dementia, Diabetes. Group 2 : Parkinson's disease, Severe Depression, Lung cancer, Bowel cancer, Prostate cancer. If any of codes -11, -13 or -17 were selected then no additional Group 1 choices were allowed. If any of codes -21, -23 or -27 were selected then no additional Group 2 choices were allowed. If the participant activated the Help button they were shown the message: Answer this question for blood relations only. If you are not sure if your father suffered from any of the listed illnesses please select Do not know. If you know your father suffered from certain listed illnesses but are unsure about others, only select the ones you are sure about. The information was collected from participants who indicated they were not adopted as a child, as defined by their answers to Field 1767 and who indicated whether their natural father was still alive or had died, as defined by their answers to Field 1797 . Note that although Breast cancer is present in Data-Coding 1010 , participants were not presented with this option when selecting Father illnesses.

Notes_zh: 这是一个外部衍生的神经质综合评分，基于基线触摸屏问卷中12个神经质行为领域的报告（字段1920、1930、1940、1950、1960、1970、1980、1990、2000、2010、2020和2030）。通过触摸屏问卷评估了参与者的12个神经质行为领域。问题包括：你的情绪经常起伏吗？你是否经常无缘无故感到“痛苦”？你是一个易怒的人吗？你的感情容易受到伤害吗？你经常感到“厌倦”吗？你会称自己为紧张的人吗？你是一个忧虑者吗？你会称自己为紧张或“高度紧张”的人吗？在经历尴尬后你会长时间担心吗？你患有“神经紧张”吗？你经常感到孤独吗？你经常被内疚感困扰吗？参与者可以回答是、否、不知道或不愿回答。该字段将这12个问题的“是”回答数量汇总为每个参与者的单一整数评分。该衍生数据字段来自格拉斯哥大学健康与福祉研究所的Jill Pell教授。关于这些字段如何衍生的方法可以在附加资源选项卡中找到。
Notes: This is an externally derived summary score of neuroticism, based on 12 neurotic behaviour domains as reported from fields 1920, 1930, 1940, 1950, 1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2030 from the touchscreen questionnaire at baseline. Participants were assessed for twelve domains of neurotic behaviours via the touchscreen questionnaire. Questions included: Does your mood often go up and down? Do you ever feel 'just miserable' for no reason? Are you an irritable person? Are your feelings easily hurt? Do you often feel 'fed-up'? Would you call yourself a nervous person? Are you a worrier? Would you call yourself tense or 'highly strung'? Do you worry too long after an embarrassing experience? Do you suffer from 'nerves'? Do you often feel lonely? Are you often troubled by feelings of guilt? Participants could answer Yes, No, Do not know or Prefer not to answer. This field summarises the number of Yes answers across these twelve questions into a single integer score for each participant. This derived data field has come from Professor Jill Pell from the Institute of Health & Wellbeing, University of Glasgow. Methods on how these fields were derived can be found in the Additional Resources tab.

Path: Assessment centre > Physical measures > Spirometry
Field_zh: 1秒用力呼气容积(FEV1)预测值
Notes_zh: 预测的1秒用力呼气容积(FEV1)是使用UK Biobank中"健康从不吸烟者"的子集计算的。"健康从不吸烟者"被选择为"曾经吸烟状态"=0且"使用欧洲呼吸学会/美国胸科学会(ERS/ATS)标准的可重复测量"=YES(1)的个体，并排除了以下情况：字段2316：表示曾经历喘息的个体："是"(1)、"不知道"(-1)或"不愿回答"(-3)。字段6152：报告"肺气肿/慢性支气管炎"(6)或"哮喘"(8)或"不愿回答"(-3)的个体。字段20002：报告以下任何情况的个体：哮喘(1111)、COPD(1112)、肺气肿/慢性支气管炎(1113)、支气管扩张(1114)、间质性肺病(1115)、石棉肺(1120)、肺纤维化(1121)、纤维化/未明确的肺泡炎(1122)、呼吸衰竭(1124)、胸膜炎(1125)、自发性/复发性气胸(1126)、其他呼吸问题(1117)。健康从不吸烟者被分为58个年龄-性别组(每个性别29个年龄组；年龄39、40和41被分为一组，年龄69、70和72被分为一组，年龄42至68各自形成一个单独的组)，并在每个年龄-性别组中拟合以下线性回归模型：FEV1 = Beta0 + Beta1 * 站立身高。然后为所有从不吸烟者("曾经吸烟状态"=0)或重度吸烟者("曾经吸烟状态"=1且"吸烟包年占生命暴露比例" >= 0.42)且"使用欧洲呼吸学会/美国胸科学会(ERS/ATS)标准的可重复测量"=YES的样本计算预测FEV1，使用来自适当年龄-性别组的Beta0和Beta1估计值：预测FEV1= (预测Beta0) + (预测Beta1) * 站立身高。五个个体因其FEV1异常值未被编码。该衍生数据字段来自莱斯特大学的Martin Tobin教授。当前字段在2021年更新，使用上述回归方法。覆盖范围扩大到包括在初始评估(实例0)中表示偶尔吸烟或"吸烟包年占生命暴露比例" < 0.42的任何参与者。原始研究小组还表示，他们现在使用GLI-2012方程来生成FEV1的预测值，详情可在https://www.ers-education.org/guidelines/global-lung-function-initiative/faq/how-to-use-the-quanjer-gli-2012-equations.aspx找到。
Notes: Predicted Forced Expiratory Volume in 1-second (FEV1), was calculated using a subset of "healthy never smokers" from UK Biobank. "Healthy never smokers", were selected as individuals with "Ever Smoking Status"=0 and with "Reproducible measure using the European Respiratory Society/American Thoracic Society (ERS/ATS) Criteria"=YES (1), with the following exclusions: Field 2316 : Individuals who indicated that they had experienced wheeze: "Yes" (1), "Do not know" (-1) or "Prefer not to answer" (-3). Field 6152 : Individuals who reported "emphysema/chronic bronchitis" (6) or "asthma" (8) or "Prefer not to answer" (-3). Field 20002 : Individuals who reported any of the following: asthma (1111), COPD (1112), emphysema/chronic bronchitis (1113), bronchiectasis (1114), interstitial lung disease (1115), asbestosis (1120), pulmonary fibrosis (1121), fibrosing/unspecified alveolitis (1122), respiratory failure (1124), pleurisy (1125), spontaneous/recurrent pneumothorax (1126), other respiratory problems (1117). Healthy never smokers were grouped into 58 age-sex bands (29 age bands per sex; ages 39, 40 and 41 were grouped into one band and ages 69, 70 and 72 were grouped into one band with ages 42 to 68 each forming a separate band) and the following linear regression model was fitted in each age-sex band: FEV1 = Beta0 + Beta1 * Standing Height Predicted FEV1 was then calculated for all samples who were never smokers ("Ever Smoking Status"=0) or heavy smokers ("Ever Smoking Status"=1 AND "Pack years as proportion of life span exposed to smoking" >= 0.42) and with "Reproducible measure using the European Respiratory Society/American Thoracic Society (ERS/ATS) Criteria"=YES, using the estimates of Beta0 and Beta1 , from the appropriate age-sex band: Predicted FEV1= (pred. Beta0 ) + (pred. Beta1 )^ * Standing Height Five individuals were outliers in terms of their FEV1 and were not coded. This derived data field has come from Professor Martin Tobin at the University of Leicester. The current field was updated in 2021, using the regression method described above. Coverage was increased to include any participant who indicated at initial assessment (instance 0) that they either occasionally smoked, or where "Pack years as proportion of life span exposed to smoking" < 0.42. The original research group additionally indicated that they now use GLI-2012 equations to produce predicted values for FEV1, details can be found at https://www.ers-education.org/guidelines/global-lung-function-initiative/faq/how-to-use-the-quanjer-gli-2012-equations.aspx .

Notes_zh: 使用变量"当前吸烟情况"(字段1239)和"过去吸烟情况"(字段1249)衍生而来。如果"当前吸烟情况"=大多数日子(1)或偶尔(2)或"过去吸烟情况"=大多数日子(1)或偶尔(2)或尝试过一两次(3)，则个体被分类为曾经吸烟者。如果"当前吸烟情况"=否(0)且"过去吸烟情况"=从未(4)，则个体被分类为从不吸烟者。对任一问题回答"不知道"(-1)、"不愿回答"(-3)和"以上都不是"(-7)的个体未被编码。该衍生数据字段来自莱斯特大学的Martin Tobin教授。
Notes: Derived using variables "Current tobacco smoking" ( Field 1239 ) and "Past tobacco smoking" ( Field 1249 ). Individual classed as Eversmoker if Current tobacco smoking= most days (1) or occasionally (2) OR Past tobacco smoking= most days (1) or occasionally (2) or tried once or twice (3). Individual were classed as Neversmoker if Current tobacco smoking= no (0) AND Past tobacco smoking= never (4). Individuals who answered to either question "Do not know" (-1) "Prefer not to answer" (-3) and "None of the above" (-7) were not coded. This derived data field has come from Professor Martin Tobin at the University of Leicester.

Field_zh: 吸烟包年
Notes_zh: 根据数据字段"曾经吸烟状态"=1，为曾经吸烟的个体计算吸烟包年，使用适当的数据：当前吸烟(无论是制造烟还是手卷烟)且大多数日子吸烟的个体(使用的吸烟数据字段：字段3436和字段6183)。过去吸烟(无论是制造烟还是手卷烟)且大多数日子吸烟的个体(使用的吸烟数据字段：字段2867、字段2897和字段2887)。当前吸雪茄/烟斗且大多数日子吸烟且以前吸过香烟的个体(使用的吸烟数据字段：字段3436、字段6194和字段6183)。吸烟包年的一般定义是每天吸烟的数量除以二十，乘以吸烟年数。吸烟年数是通过减去开始吸烟的年龄与停止吸烟的年龄来计算的。每天吸烟数量 / 20 * (停止吸烟年龄 - 开始吸烟年龄)。对于根据数据字段2907或3486戒烟超过6个月的个体，该数字通过从吸烟年数中减去六个月来调整。每天吸烟数量 / 20 * (停止吸烟年龄 - 开始吸烟年龄 - 0.5)。注意：在16岁之前开始并戒烟的个体被编码为NA。对于在16岁之前开始但在16岁之后戒烟的个体，他们的开始年龄被设置为16岁。报告开始和停止吸烟年龄相同且报告戒烟超过6个月的个体的吸烟包年被设置为0。该衍生数据字段来自莱斯特大学的Martin Tobin教授。
Notes: Pack years calculated for individuals who have ever smoked according to data field Ever smoking status=1, using appropriate data: Current cigarette (either manufactured or hand rolled) smokers who smoke most days (smoking data fields used: Field 3436 and Field 6183 ). Past cigarette (either manufactured or hand rolled) smokers who smoked most days (smoking data fields used: Field 2867 , Field 2897 and Field 2887 ). Current cigar/pipe smokers who smoked most days and previously smoked cigarettes (smoking data fields used: Field 3436 , Field 6194 and Field 6183 ). The general definition of a pack year is the number of cigarettes smoked per day, divided by twenty, multiplied by the number of years of smoking. The number of years of smoking is calculated by substracting the age of starting smoking from the age smoking was stopped. Number of cigarettes per day / 20 * (Age stopped smoking - Age start smoking) The figure is adjusted for individuals who gave up smoking for more than 6 months, according to data fields 2907 or 3486 by subtracting six months from the number of years of smoking. Number of cigarettes per day / 20 * (Age stopped smoking - Age start smoking - 0.5) Note: Individuals who started and gave up smoking before 16 years of age were coded as NA. For individuals who started smoking before 16 but gave up after 16, their age start was set as 16. Individuals who reported starting and stopping smoking at the same age and reported giving up smoking for more than 6 months had pack-years set at 0. This derived data field has come from Professor Martin Tobin at the University of Leicester.
Data: 180,134 items of data are available, covering 153,624 participants.Defined-instances run from 0 to 3, labelled using Instancing 2.Units of measurement are years.

Path: Genomics > Imputation
Field_zh: 基于基因型的插补（TOPMed）
Notes_zh: 使用TOPMed R2参考面板进行的基因型插补（区块数），由TOPMed信息研究中心完成。插补方法详见：Taliun等人在《自然》期刊的论文（2021）。数据经GRCh37转GRCh38坐标后，以1Mb分段插补并合并，保留R^2≥0.1的标记。最终数据以8位精度的BGEN格式分发。
Notes: Imputation from genotype using the TOPMed R2 panel, performed by the TOPMed Informatics Research Center. Primary description of the imputation data can be found in: Taliun, D., Harris, D.N., Kessler, M.D. et al. Sequencing of 53,831 diverse genomes from the NHLBI TOPMed Program. Nature 590, 290-299 (2021) https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03205-y After phasing the UK Biobank genetic data (carried out on 81 chromosomal chunks using Eagle v.2.4), the phased data were converted from GRCh37 to GRCh38 using LiftOver. Imputation was performed using Minimac4 v1.0.2 ( https://genome.sph.umich.edu/wiki/Minimac4 ). The reference panel is the TOPMed R2 panel, which is available to public at https://imputation.biodatacatalyst.nhlbi.nih.gov . Imputation was performed in 1Mb chunks and merged back together by chromosome. Due to large data size, markers with poor imputation were not retained (excluded Minimac4 imputation quality metric R^2 < 0.1). Across all the chromosomes, 677,037 markers were used for imputation. For distribution to UK Biobank, output Minimac4 VCF files were converted to BGEN format using qctool v2.0.8. The conversion used the Genotype Probability (GP) field from source VCF and the probabilities are stored using 8 bit precision. Details on contributing cohorts for the TOPMed Imputataion Panel can be seen in Extended Table 3 of Sequencing of 53,831 diverse genomes from the NHLBI TOPMed Program. Nature 590, 290-299 (2021). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03205-y .
Data: 487,180 items are available, covering 487,180 participants.Units of measurement are blocks.

Path: Genomics > Genotypes > Genotyping process and sample QC
Field_zh: 基因型测量批次
Notes_zh: 基因分型使用了两个密切相关的芯片，分别称为UK BiLEVE芯片和UK Biobank Axiom芯片。BiLEVE芯片先设计并用于约5万名参与者。随后设计的UKB Axiom芯片尽可能最大化与BiLEVE芯片的标记重叠，用于剩余的约45万名参与者。UKB Axiom芯片有超过82万个SNP和插入缺失标记，UK BiLEVE芯片非常相似，有超过95%的共同内容。样本以约4700个为一批进行分析。前33批（UKBiLEVE_b1-11和Batch_b001-022）的初步结果提前18个月发布。这些批次的CEL文件随后作为完整发布质量控制过程的一部分重新分析，导致相关调用有微小变化。
Notes: Genotyping was done using two closely related arrays, referred to as the UK BiLEVE array and the UK Biobank Axiom array. The BiLEVE array was designed first and run on ~50,000 participants. The UKB Axiom array was designed subsequently with a view to maximizing marker overlap as much as possible between the arrays and run on the remaining ~450,000 participants. The UKB Axiom array had over 820,000 SNPs and indel markers, and the UK BiLEVE array was very similar with over 95% common content. Samples were analysed in batches of approximately 4700 items. Interim results from first 33 batches (UKBiLEVE_b1-11 and Batch_b001-022) were released 18 months ahead of the remainder. The CEL files from these interim batches were subsequently re-analysed as part of the QC process for the full release, and this resulted in minor changes to the associated calls.

Please note that this is a raw measure and has not been adjusted to remove technical variation. We strongly recommend that for any analysis, researchers use the technically adjusted measures provided in Field 22191 (Adjusted T/S ratio) or Field 22192 (Z-adjusted T/S). Details of the technical adjustment can also be found in Codd, V. et al ( https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.03.18.21253457 .)

Path: Genomics > Telomeres
Field: T/S ratio for regression dilution bias
Field_zh: 回归稀释偏倚校正T/S比值
Notes_zh: 为评估白细胞端粒长度的个体内变异，对1351名UK Biobank参与者（具有两个平均间隔5.5年的独立DNA样本）进行配对测量。这些样本分别来自基线访视和一次随访访视。由于测量在相同技术条件下成对进行，无需额外技术校正。因重新分装测量，这些数据可能与主数据集（字段22190/22191/22192）不一致，应独立使用。完整实验细节详见Codd, V.等人研究(https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.03.18.21253457)，应用示例参见Codd V等人(https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.03.23.21253516)。校正回归稀释偏倚时，字段22191建议使用0.65校正因子，字段22192建议0.68。
Notes: To gain an estimate of within-individual variation in leucocyte telomere length, paired measurements were made for 1351 UK Biobank participants for whom two separate DNA samples were available (taken at a mean difference of 5.5 years apart). These samples were taken from the baseline visit and one follow-up visit. As these measurements were performed in pairs (under the same technical conditions and parameters), no further technical adjustments were necessary. These measurements may not correspond to those for the same individuals within the main datasets ( Field 22190 , Field 22191 , Field 22192 ) due to re-plating and re-measurement of the sample to produce the paired measurements for this specific analysis. For this reason, these data should be used independently of the main datasets and not in combination. Full details of this experiment can be found in Codd, V. et al ( https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.03.18.21253457 ), and exemplar use of the derived regression dilution ratio can be found in Codd V et al ( https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.03.23.21253516 ). Researchers wishing to correct for regression dilution bias should use a correction factor of 0.65 for Field 22191 and a correction factor of 0.68 for Field 22192 .

Notes: Please note that this field is obsolete and researchers should use the updated home location history data instead. Please see the description on Category 150 for more information. In addition, we have identified a number of dates that have been incorrectly processed in the construction of Field 22700 and which are up to 30 months different from the participant's change of address notification. Notes_zh: 血型是通过对基因型的UK Biobank参与者使用ABO基因上的三个SNP（rs505922、rs8176719和rs8176746）进行插补的。rs8176719缺失被视为单倍型O的指示；对于没有rs8176719结果的参与者，rs505922的T用于指示O型。rs8176746的T用于指示B型。这是基于以下方法开发的：Melzer等人2008年（https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1000072），Pare等人2008年（https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1000118），Wolpin等人2010年（https://doi.org/10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-09-2993），Groot等人2020年（https://doi.org/10.1161/ATVBAHA.119.313658）。
Notes: Blood type was imputed for genotyped UK Biobank participants using three SNPs (rs505922, rs8176719, and rs8176746) in the ABO gene on chromosome 9q34.2. rs8176719 deletion was taken as indicative of haplotype O; For participants with no result for rs8176719, rs505922 of T was used to indicate type O. Type B was indicated by T at rs8176746. This was developed from the methodology of: Melzer et al 2008 (https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1000072) Pare et al 2008 (https:// doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1000118) Wolpin et al 2010 (https:// doi.org/10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-09-2993) Groot et al 2020 (https://doi.org/10.1161/ATVBAHA.119.313658)
Data: 487,220 items of data are available, covering 487,220 participants, encoded using Data-Coding 169.

Notes: The exact location of the head and the radio-frequency receive coil in the scanner can affect data quality and imaging-derived phenotypes. The lateral brain position is the X-co-ordinate (left-right) of the centre of the brain mask within the scanner. Coding 1317 defines 1 special value: -999999 represents "Measure not cleanly recoverable from data"

Notes_zh: 2010年英格兰多重剥夺指数是对小区域层面多重剥夺的测量。该指数基于可被单独识别和测量的不同剥夺领域概念。这些领域由居住在该地区的个体经历。根据人们经历的剥夺类型数量，他们可能被计入一个或多个领域。每个领域代表人们经历的特定形式的剥夺，并可使用多个指标单独测量。英格兰多重剥夺指数确定了七个领域：收入剥夺、就业剥夺、健康剥夺与残疾、教育技能与培训剥夺、住房与服务障碍、生活环境剥夺和犯罪。各领域可单独用作特定剥夺形式的测量，也可通过适当权重组合成综合多重剥夺指数，用于根据居民经历的剥夺程度对英格兰所有小区域进行排序。与两个补充指数（影响儿童收入剥夺指数和影响老年人收入剥夺指数）共同构成英格兰剥夺指数体系。这些统计数据可识别全国最贫困和最富裕地区，并提供不同地区居民面临问题的信息。
Notes: The English Indices of Deprivation 2010 are measures of multiple deprivation at the small area level. The model of multiple deprivation which underpins the Indices of Deprivation 2010 is based on the idea of distinct domains of deprivation which can be recognised and measured separately. These domains are experienced by individuals living in an area. People may be counted in one or more of the domains, depending on the number of types of deprivation that they experience. Each domain represents a specific form of deprivation experienced by people and each can be measured individually using a number of indicators. Seven distinct domains have been identified in the English Indices of Deprivation; Income Deprivation, Employment Deprivation, Health Deprivation and Disability, Education Skills and Training Deprivation, Barriers to Housing and Services, Living Environment Deprivation, and Crime. Individual domains can be used in isolation as measures of each specific form of deprivation. They can also be combined, using appropriate weights, into a single overall Index of Multiple Deprivation which can be used to rank every small area in England according to the deprivation experienced by the people living there. Along with two supplementary indices, Income Deprivation Affecting Children Index and Income Deprivation Affecting Older People Index, they form the English Indices of Deprivation. These statistics allow the most, and least, deprived areas of the country to be identified as well as providing information about the issues faced by people living in different parts of the country.

Notes: The Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation 2008 is the official measure of deprivation for small areas in Wales. It was developed for the Welsh Assembly Government by the Assembly's Statistical Directorate and the Local Government Data Unit (Wales). The WIMD 2008 is made up of eight separate domains (or kinds) of deprivation: income, employment, health, education, housing, environment, access to services, and community safety. Each of them was based on a range of different indicators which meant that they were measured in different ways using different units. So before they could be combined the measurements had to be transformed to make them compatible. For example, if the height of something had been measured in metres and the weight in kilograms it would not make sense simply to add them together. Income and employment were classed as the most important factors, and they were given the biggest weighting in the overall index. Although there is more to deprivation than poverty, not having enough money or a job is a big part of it.

Notes: The Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation (SIMD) 2009 identifies small area concentrations of multiple deprivation across Scotland in a consistent manner. The SIMD combines data from seven distinct domains or topic areas all of which are considered to be important contributors to deprivation levels. These domains have remained the same as in the previous version of the index, published in 2006, and the data used in compiling each one is the most appropriate and up to date that was available at the time of constructing the index. The SIMD is a relative measure of deprivation that uses 6,505 data zones across Scotland as its unit of comparison. The rank applied to each of these data zones identifies each as being more or less deprived than all the others in the country. The rankings run from 1 being the most deprived to 6505 being the least deprived. Therefore the smaller the ranking the more deprived the data zone. As the SIMD is a relative measure it cannot show how much more deprived one data zone is than another, e.g. that a data zone ranked 5 is twice as deprived as a data zone ranked 10. In the same way the distance between each ranking can vary - so the gap between the data zones ranked 16 and 17 could be very small while the gap between those ranked 17 and 18 could be much bigger. The SIMD can be used to identify the small areas with the highest concentrations of multiple deprivation in Scotland using either the overall index or the individual domains. The most commonly used cut off levels are 10%, 15% or 20% - although different cut offs may be required depending on individual policy or organisational focus.

Field_zh: 抗体自测试剂盒类型
Notes_zh: 新冠抗体自测研究的每位参与者会收到邮寄的Fortress快速检测试剂盒或AbC-19快速检测试剂盒。Fortress试剂盒可区分IgG抗体（长期）和IgM抗体（短期），AbC-19试剂盒仅检测IgG抗体阳性结果。资源4513和4520展示了两种试剂盒的技术规格。
Notes: Each participant of the Coronavirus Self-test Antibody Study received a self-administered lateral flow test through the post that was either a Fortress Fast COVID-19 Test or an AbC-19 TM Rapid Test. Fortress kits produced results that differentiated between IgG antibodies (long-term) and IgM antibodies (short-term). AbC-19 TM kits provided only positive test results for IgG antibodies. Resource 4513 and Resource 4520 show the technical specifications of the Fortress and AbC-19 test kits.

Notes: Participants self-reported the result of their COVID-19 antibody self-testing device, either by submitting it online via their UK Biobank participant account, using a paper questionnaire returned to UK Biobank in the mail or via phone to the UK Biobank Participant Resource Centre. The rationale for this was: around 1 in 5 primary procedures lacked a corresponding value for OPDATE in HESIN_OPER; some recorded OPDATEs were inconsistent with the other date fields such as EPISTART, ADMIDATE, EPIEND and DISDATE (most likely due to data entry errors); for those episodes with a value for OPDATE recorded the majority were the same as the value of EPISTART, with around 99% of OPDATE values within 7 days of the value of EPISTART; values of EPISTART/ADMIDATE are more complete and thus may provide greater consistency across data providers. See the Operations tab of the Hospital Inpatient Data Dictionary ( Resource 141140 ) for further information about these fields. Please note OPCS-3 coded hospital inpatient data are only available for older Scottish hospital records.

Notes_zh: 该字段为每个参与者提供了字段41200中每个主要程序首次在其医院住院记录中记录的日期。可以通过数组结构将此日期与字段41200链接。请注意，我们选择用发作开始日期（HESIN表中的EPISTART）或（如果缺失）入院开始日期（HESIN表中的ADMIDATE）填充此数据字段，而不是使用手术日期（HESIN_OPER表中的OPDATE）。这样做的理由是：大约五分之一的主要程序在HESIN_OPER中没有对应的OPDATE值；一些记录的OPDATE与其他日期字段（如EPISTART、ADMIDATE、EPIEND和DISDATE）不一致（很可能是由于数据输入错误）；对于那些记录了OPDATE值的发作，大多数与EPISTART的值相同，大约99%的OPDATE值在EPISTART值的7天内；EPISTART/ADMIDATE的值更完整，因此可能在数据提供者之间提供更大的一致性。有关这些字段的更多信息，请参阅医院住院数据字典（资源141140）的操作选项卡。
Notes: This field provides, for each participant, the dates when each of the main procedures in Field 41200 was first recorded in the participant's hospital inpatient records. The date can be linked to Field 41200 by using the array structure. Please note that we have opted to populate this data-field with the episode start date (EPISTART in the HESIN table) or, if that was missing, the admission start date (ADMIDATE in the HESIN table) rather than use the operation date (OPDATE in the HESIN_OPER table). The rationale for this was: around 1 in 5 primary procedures lacked a corresponding value for OPDATE in HESIN_OPER; some recorded OPDATEs were inconsistent with the other date fields such as EPISTART, ADMIDATE, EPIEND and DISDATE (most likely due to data entry errors); for those episodes with a value for OPDATE recorded the majority were the same as the value of EPISTART, with around 99% of OPDATE values within 7 days of the value of EPISTART; values of EPISTART/ADMIDATE are more complete and thus may provide greater consistency across data providers. See the Operations tab of the Hospital Inpatient Data Dictionary ( Resource 141140 ) for further information about these fields.

Path: Additional exposures > Physical activity measurement
Field_zh: 加速度强度时间序列
Notes_zh: 这些时间序列文件描述了参与者每五秒钟的加速度计测量的身体活动强度。每个测量值代表每个五秒时期/期间记录的所有样本的平均矢量幅度。此文件可能对有兴趣按时间分析加速度计测量的身体活动的人有用。第一列包含加速度值，测量单位为毫重力。第二列指示这是实际测量(值=<空白>)还是估算值(值=1)。每次读数的时间可以从第一行推断出来，它描述了数据的开始和结束时间。每个后续读数增加五秒。例如，"加速度(mg) - 2014-05-07 13:29:50 - 2014-05-13 09:50:25 - sampleRate = 5秒，估算"表示第一次测量时间为2014-05-07 13:29:50，第二次为2014-05-07 13:29:55，第三次为2014-05-07 13:30:00...最后一次为2014-05-13 09:50:25。原始状态下的文件通常每个760KB，压缩后通常约为170KB。
Notes: These time-series files describe a participant's accelerometer measured physical activity intensity every five seconds. Each measurement represents the average vector magnitude across all samples recorded in each five second epoch/period. This file may be useful for those interested in analysing accelerometer measured physical activity by time. The first column contains the acceleration value where the units of measurement are milli-gravity. The second column indicates whether this is an actual measurement (value = <blank>) or imputed (value = 1). The time associated with each reading can be inferred from the very first row, which describes the start and end times of the data. Each successive reading is incremented by five seconds. For example, "acceleration (mg) - 2014-05-07 13:29:50 - 2014-05-13 09:50:25 - sampleRate = 5 seconds, imputed" indicates that the first measurement time is at 2014-05-07 13:29:50, the second at 2014-05-07 13:29:55, the third at 2014-05-07 13:30:00 ... and the last at 2014-05-13 09:50:25. Files are typically 760KB each in the raw state and usually compress to around 170KB.

Field_zh: 蔬菜消费者
Notes_zh: 提问内容："您昨天是否食用了任何豆类、扁豆、土豆或蔬菜？包括新鲜、罐装、冷冻、干燥的；薯条、沙拉、凉拌卷心菜、烤豆、鹰嘴豆、炖菜中的蔬菜、馅饼等。" 如果参与者点击了帮助功能，将显示消息：请包括所有蔬菜，无论是单独食用、作为配菜还是在特定菜肴/餐点中（如炖菜或馅饼）。一份蔬菜的份量通常是作为主菜配菜的典型份量。例如，如果您吃了烤肉晚餐，包括肉、土豆、胡萝卜和豌豆，大多数人会吃一份土豆、一份胡萝卜和一份豌豆。对于不足以单独计算的小份蔬菜（例如炖菜中的蔬菜），请估算份数并记录在"蔬菜块"下。一份大约是用大勺（通常在食堂或自助餐中使用的大勺）盛取的量。示例：牛肉炖胡萝卜和欧洲萝卜可能含有足够的蔬菜，可以算作半份胡萝卜加半份欧洲萝卜（如果炖菜中有很多蔬菜，甚至可能算作一份）。如果没有，最好将蔬菜记录为半份"蔬菜块"。对于可能不知道具体类型的蔬菜选择（例如商店购买的蔬菜馅饼或朋友烹饪的炒菜），请估算总量并记录在"蔬菜块"下。橄榄应已在之前的"咸味零食"部分记录。如果您的蔬菜不在列表中，请将其记录在列表底部的"其他"下。
Notes: Question asked: "Did you eat any beans, lentils, potatoes or vegetables yesterday? Include fresh, tinned, frozen, dried; chips, salad, coleslaw, baked beans, chickpeas, veg in stews, pies etc." If the participant activated the Help feature they were shown the message: Please include all vegetables, whether they are eaten by themselves, as an accompaniment or within a particular dish/meal such as a stew or pie. A serving of vegetables would be the typical amount dished up as an accompaniment to main meal. e.g. if you had a roast dinner with meat, potatoes, carrots and peas, most people would have one serving of potatoes, one serving of carrots and one serving of peas. For small amounts of vegetables that are not big enough to be counted individually (e.g. in a stew), please guess the number of servings and record that under Vegetable pieces. A serving is about the amount that would be dished up using a serving spoon (large spoon typically used in canteens or self-service buffets). Example: a beef stew with carrot and parsnip may have enough vegetables in it to count as a half serving of carrots plus a half serving of parsnip (possibly even a whole serving if there are a lot of vegetables in the stew). If not, it may be better to record the vegetables as a half serving of Vegetable pieces. For a selection of vegetables where the precise type may be unknown (for example in a shop bought vegetable pie or a stir fry cooked by a friend) please guess the total amount and record that under Vegetable pieces. Olives should have been recorded earlier under 'Savoury Snacks'. If your vegetable is not on the list, please record it under 'Other' located at the bottom of the list.

Notes_zh: 问题内容："您昨天是否食用了任何水果？" 如果参与者点击了帮助功能，将显示以下信息：包括新鲜、冷冻、干制、罐装或煮熟的水果。帮助部分说明：请包含所有水果，无论是单独食用还是作为甜点或咸味菜肴的一部分（如水果派或酥皮点心；用苹果烹制的猪肉）。在煮熟和干制水果类别下记录的水果不需要在列表中单独记录。数量较少不足以单独计算或种类不明确的水果（如混合水果沙拉中的水果），请估算总量并记录在混合水果类别下。由于罐装水果通常以片或块的形式出现，请以份数而非整个水果回答。用于制作冰沙的水果不应在此处记录，水果冰沙应在饮料部分记录。巧克力覆盖的水果（如巧克力葡萄干）和酸奶覆盖的水果（如酸奶菠萝）不应在此处记录，而应记录在甜点零食部分（前几页）。包含在谷物食品中的干果（如葡萄干麦片和Optivita）不应在此处记录，因为它们应在谷物页面记录。如果您食用的水果不在列表中，请记录在列表底部的其他类别中。
Notes: Question asked: "Did you eat any fruit yesterday?" If the participant activated the Help feature they were shown the message: Include fresh, frozen, dried, canned or cooked. Help section: Please include all fruit, whether eaten by itself or as part of a sweet or savoury dish (e.g. fruit pie or crumble; pork cooked with apple). Fruits recorded under cooked & dried should not be recorded individually further down the list. Small amounts of fruit that are not big enough to be counted individually, or where the precise type may be unknown (e.g. in a mixed fruit salad), please guess the total amount and record that under Mixed fruit. As canned fruit usually comes in segments or slices, please give your answer in servings rather than as whole fruit. Fruit used in a smoothie should not be recorded here. The fruit smoothie should have been recorded in the drinks section. Chocolate covered fruit (e.g. chocolate raisins) and yogurt covered fruit (e.g. yogurt coated pineapple) should not be recorded here. Instead record it under sweet snacks (several pages earlier). Dried fruit that is included with cereals such as Sultana Bran and Optivita should not be record here because it should have been recorded on the cereals page. If your fruit is not on the list, please record it under Other located at the bottom of the list.

Field: Time spent doing vigorous physical activity
Field_zh: 进行剧烈体育活动的时间
Notes_zh: 问题询问：'昨天，您大约花了多长时间进行需要剧烈努力、让您呼吸急促的活动？例如跑步、骑车上坡、搬运重家具上楼、武术、竞技体育或高强度锻炼。'如果参与者激活了帮助功能，他们会看到以下信息：请估计您昨天总共花了多少时间进行需要剧烈努力的活动。这些类型的剧烈活动需要良好的体能和力量。工作中的例子：体力要求高，如搬运重物（如砖块）或搬运中等重量的物体上坡、上楼或上梯子、大量铲土等。跑步：不是慢跑 - 每小时5英里（12分钟跑1英里）或更快。骑自行车：剧烈努力，速度较快或上坡，山地自行车。运动/锻炼：剧烈努力，包括有氧踏板操、高强度循环训练、拳击/武术、竞技性团队运动如足球、攀岩、激烈游泳、激烈滑雪（竞速、越野）等。
Notes: Question asked: "Yesterday, about how long did you spend doing activities that needed vigorous effort, making you breathe hard? For example running, cycling uphill, carrying heavy furniture upstairs, martial arts, competitive sports or intensive exercise." If the participant activated the Help feature they were shown the message: Please guess how long you spent in total doing activities requiring vigorous effort yesterday. These types of strenuous activities require a good level of fitness and strength. At work: physically demanding such as carrying heavy objects (e.g. bricks) or carrying moderately heavy objects uphill, up stairs or up ladders, heavy shovelling etc. Running: not slow - 5mph (1 mile in 12 minutes) or faster. Cycling: vigorous effort, reasonably fast or uphill, mountain biking. Sports/exercise: vigorous effort including step aerobics, intensive circuit training, boxing/martial arts, competitively played team games such as football, rock climbing, energetic swimming, energetic skiing (racing, cross-country) etc.

Path: Online follow-up > Diet by 24-hour recall > Physical activity yesterday
Field: Time spent doing moderate physical activity
Field_zh: 进行中等体育活动的时间
Notes_zh: 问题询问：'昨天，您大约花了多长时间进行需要中等努力、让您有些呼吸急促的活动？例如走上楼、去健身房、慢跑、活力舞蹈、有氧运动、大多数运动、使用重型电动工具和其他体力要求的DIY和园艺活动。'如果参与者激活了帮助功能，他们会看到以下信息：请估计您昨天总共花了多少时间进行中等努力的活动。这些活动让您感到的疲劳程度取决于您个人的体能水平（体能较好的人不会像体能较差的人那样呼吸急促）。工作中的例子：搬运中等重量的物体、推轮椅、使用重型电动工具、活跃的农场工作、照顾农场动物、煤矿开采、教授体育等。步行：非常轻快的步行或上坡步行、上楼步行、背包旅行、行军、健走、使用拐杖等。慢跑：定义为以温和的速度跑步。舞蹈：快速或活力舞蹈（不是缓慢的交际舞）。骑自行车：通勤或休闲骑行（不是比赛或上坡骑行），也包括骑独轮车。运动/锻炼：俯卧撑、举重、健身房锻炼、有氧运动、非竞技性团队运动如足球、高尔夫、骑马、网球、田径、温和游泳、滑雪、滑冰等。园艺：包括需要体力的任务，如挖土、轻度到中度铲土、割草、使用重型电动工具、劈柴等。DIY/家居装修：包括相当费力的任务，如搭建围栏、锯硬木、清理排水沟、使用重型电动工具、打磨地板等。
Notes: Question asked: "Yesterday, about how long did you spend doing activities that needed moderate effort, making you somewhat short of breath? For example walking upstairs, going to the gym, jogging, energetic dancing, aerobics, most sports, using heavy power tools and other physically demanding DIY & gardening." If the participant activated the Help feature they were shown the message: Please guess how long you spent in total doing medium effort activities yesterday. How tired you feel from these types of activities will depend on your individual level of fitness (so a fitter person will not need to breathe as hard as a less fit person). At work: carrying moderately heavy objects, pushing a wheelchair, using heavy power tools, active farm work, taking care of farm animals, coal mining, teaching sports etc. Walking: very brisk walking or walking uphill, walking upstairs, backpacking, marching, power walking, using crutches etc. Jogging: this is defined as running at a gentle pace. Dancing: fast or energetic dancing (not slow ballroom dancing). Cycling: for travelling to work or leisure (not racing or uphill) cycling, also includes unicycling. Sports/exercise: push-ups, weight-lifting, working out in a gym, aerobics, team sports (not competitively played) such as football, golf, horse riding, tennis, track & field, gentle swimming, skiing, ice-skating etc. Gardening: includes energetic tasks such as digging, light to moderate shovelling, mowing the lawn, using heavy power tools, chopping wood etc. DIY/home improvement: includes such fairly demanding tasks such as building a fence, sawing hardwood, cleaning gutters, using heavy power tools, sanding floors etc.

Field: Time spent doing light physical activity
Field_zh: 进行轻度体育活动的时间
Notes_zh: 问题询问：'昨天，您大约花了多长时间进行需要轻度努力、涉及移动但不会让您呼吸急促的活动？例如购物、烹饪、家务、玩飞镖/台球/保龄球、步行、轻度锻炼如伸展、温和舞蹈、照顾人/动物、装饰、轻度园艺、演奏乐器。'如果参与者激活了帮助功能，他们会看到以下信息：请估计您昨天总共花了多少时间进行需要相对较少体力的活动。这些类型的活动不应让您呼吸急促（或仅轻微呼吸急促），但如果长时间进行可能会让您感到疲劳。步行：不应让您呼吸急促，包括抱着孩子或推婴儿车步行、在家中走动、在办公室走动、休闲步行等。工作中的例子：轻度木工、铺床、清洁、电工工作、管道工作、油漆/装饰、轻度农场任务如收割、驱赶牛/动物、锁匠、机器/设备操作员、组装/修理、指挥交通、教授瑜伽、调酒、护理、裁缝、戏剧工作（表演、后台工作）等。家务：包括轻度和重度家务，如清洁、擦洗、洗衣、晾衣服、吸尘、熨烫、烹饪、喂宠物、收拾购物物品、铺床等。购物：食品和非食品购物。演奏乐器：坐着或站着演奏乐器（即不在行进乐队中）。也包括指挥。照顾：儿童、病人、老人、动物。园艺：给植物/草坪浇水、除草、使用骑乘式割草机、采摘水果/鲜花等。DIY/家居装修：一般木工、装饰（油漆、贴墙纸、抹灰、刮擦）、汽车修理、布线、管道等。游戏：飞镖、斯诺克/台球、保龄球、槌球、飞盘（轻度/中度）、玩接球、迷你高尔夫等。舞蹈：不会让您呼吸急促的慢舞。运动/锻炼：不会让您呼吸急促的活动，如伸展、哈他瑜伽、骑马（步行速度）、帆船（非竞技性）、使用动力船等。
Notes: Question asked: "Yesterday, about how long did you spend doing activities that needed some light effort, involving movement but not making you short of breath? For example shopping, cooking, housework, playing darts/pool/bowls, walking, light exercise like stretching, gentle dancing, caring for people/animals, decorating, light gardening, playing musical instruments." If the participant activated the Help feature they were shown the message: Please guess how long you spent in total doing activities requiring relatively little physical effort yesterday. These types of activities should not get you out of breath (or only a little out of breath) but can make you tired if carried out for a long time. Walking: should not get you out of breath, includes walking whilst carrying a child or pushing a buggy, walking about the home, walking about the office, walking for pleasure etc. At work: light carpentry, making beds, cleaning, electrical work, plumbing, painting/decorating, light farming tasks such as harvesting, rounding up cattle/animals, locksmith, machine/equipment operator, assembling/repairing, directing traffic, teaching yoga, bartending, nursing, tailoring, theatre work (acting, working backstage) etc. Housework: includes both light and heavy housework such as cleaning, scrubbing, washing, hanging the washing to dry, vacuuming, ironing, cooking, feeding pets, putting away the shopping, making beds etc. Shopping: food and non-food shopping. Playing musical instruments: playing instruments whilst seated or standing (i.e. not in a marching band). Also includes conducting. Caring: children, sick, elderly, animals. Gardening: watering the plants/lawn, weeding, using a ride-on lawn mower, picking fruit/flowers etc. DIY/home improvement: general carpentry, decorating (painting, putting up wallpaper, plastering, scraping), car repairs, wiring, plumbing etc. Games: darts, snooker/pool, bowling, bowls, croquet, frisbee (gentle/moderate), playing catch, mini golf etc. Dancing: slow dancing that does not get you out of breath. Sports/exercise: activities that should not get you out of breath such as stretching, hatha yoga, horse riding (at walking pace), sailing (not competitive), using power boats etc.
